email.body1:
Charles, saw NobleAI keeps landing enterprise partners like ICL, Viakable, and Vickers Oils for materials R&D.

That kind of traction usually opens more in-market accounts in the Central region than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for NobleAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Charles, quick follow-up for NobleAI.

As enterprise logos stack up, the gap is usually that nobody knows exactly how many meetings the Central team must book to hit the number this quarter. The math shows up late, and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NobleAI needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Charles, last bit of proof for NobleAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NobleAI's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Charles, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to NobleAI either way.
